meta.title: Malina - farm management for the raspberry plantation
meta.description: Malina ports the 1Çatı ERP ecosystem to a raspberry farm near Almaty: location hierarchy, RBAC, picking tasks with photo evidence, cold chain and chain-of-evidence record keeping.

hero.headline: Market leadership is won not through tonnage, but through verifiable traceability.
hero.subheadline: Malina takes the domain-neutral mechanics of 1Çatı - location hierarchy, lock logic, evidence chains, role permissions, offline queues - and points them at the raspberry farm: cooling curve, batch, source block, picker and treatment record for every delivery.
hero.imageAlt: Trellised rows of a raspberry plantation - placeholder image, to be replaced with real material from the farm
hero.stat1Label: hard limit from picking to pre-cooling
hero.stat3Label: baseline signed with the client on 01 Oct 2026

landing.zonesLead: Structured as in the pitch dossier. Each zone bundles the building blocks 1Çatı contributes, plus the four that are built from scratch.
landing.proofTitle: An unbroken chain of evidence for every delivery
landing.proofLead: The raspberry forces it: no protective shell, cooled within 60 minutes, harvested on a two-to-three-day cycle. 1Çatı can do chains of evidence - just for the wrong domain.

kuehlkurve.title: Cooling curve
kuehlkurve.text: Time and temperature from picking to pre-cooling, a hard 60-minute limit.

charge.title: Batch
charge.text: Crate identity in the field via QR, every crate assigned to a batch.

herkunftsblock.title: Source block
herkunftsblock.text: Row block, variety and harvest day as cost object and origin declaration.

pfluecker.title: Picker
pfluecker.text: Brigade and person per task, output and quality factor recorded.

behandlung.title: Treatment record
behandlung.text: Spray record per block, harvest locked until the pre-harvest interval expires.

stunde.title: The hour after picking
stunde.text: Cold-chain clock with a 60-minute threshold and temperature-logger link. Without a physical pre-cooling facility the entire price spread collapses.

herbstfenster.title: The autumn window of the everbearing varieties
herbstfenster.text: Rotation-plan engine for the multi-week harvest run from August to the first frost, picking interval two to three days per row block.

zugang.title: Traceability as an access advantage
zugang.text: An unbroken chain of evidence opens the door to organised trade. An ERP that can do chains of evidence is not a nice-to-have here.

aggregation.title: Aggregating neighbouring farms
aggregation.text: The neighbouring farm becomes a vendor, the purchased volume an invoice line, with separate batch tracking. One brand instead of buying land.

landing.kpiTitle: 14 key figures the client signs off
landing.kpiLead: Loss rate, share of marketable punnets, time to cooling, picking output, delivery reliability, contribution margin, ЕСУТД coverage and more.
landing.kpiFootnote: Prototype: placeholder values. The real calculation follows with the harvest data.
landing.complianceTitle: State obligations Malina has to reflect
landing.complianceLead: In 2026 Kazakhstan introduced a run of new obligations. The security gates from 1Çatı already meet the spirit of them; the legal references are swapped out rather than merely translated.

steuer.title: Tax Code 2026
steuer.text: New version of the Tax Code, affects contribution margin and cost objects.

warenbegleit.title: Electronic goods-accompanying document
warenbegleit.text: ЭСФ and virtual stock via the existing integration_outbox pattern, not a home-built accounting system.

ki.title: AI Act No. 230-VIII
ki.text: Transparency notice and consent for the retrieval AI chat, re-drafted under Kazakh law.

digitalkodex.title: Digital Code No. 255-VIII
digitalkodex.text: Data residency: the hosting location for the QR, offline-sync and AI architecture must be reviewed legally.

datenschutz.title: Tightened data-protection law
datenschutz.text: In force since 24 Aug 2026. The digest pattern for identities from 1Çatı fits; the target shifts to onboarding of clients and neighbouring farms.

esutd.title: ЕСУТД employment-contract registration
esutd.text: Every seasonal contract is registered in the state system, connected via the outbox.

landing.ctaTitle: A tangible system instead of concept slides
landing.ctaLead: Milestone A: a viewable prototype with look and feature scope - the basis for internal sign-off before the on-site analysis week.

feld.name: Field
feld.description: Location model, row-block status including the pre-harvest-interval lock, picking tasks with photo evidence, rotation plan and weather link.

hof.name: Yard
hof.description: Pre-cooling with a 60-minute KPI, temperature logger, collection rounds, QR crate identification and electronic delivery note.

buero.name: Office
buero.description: RBAC roles, contribution margin per row block, quality-factor pay, document management, compliance cockpit and state integrations.

markt.name: Market
markt.description: Variety and quota catalogue, B2B portal, retrieval AI chat, aggregator platform for neighbouring farms and multilingual training.

footer.blurb: Malina, Russian for raspberry. An internal blueprint built on the 1Çatı ERP ecosystem, aimed at the raspberry farm near Almaty.
footer.prototypeNote: Internal proof of concept. Not a contractually committed scope. All imagery is placeholder material from royalty-free sources.

milestoneBItems.status: Row-block status management including the lock state after plant protection
milestoneBItems.tasks: Picking tasks with photo evidence from workforce_tasks and media_reports
milestoneBItems.kpi: Dashboard skeleton with KPI tiles as structure

roles.switcherHint: Switch demo role - controls the visible navigation

descriptions.admin: Full configuration, user and role management, oversight of sensitive finance, access and integration matters.
descriptions.betriebsleitung: Daily plantation operations, tasks, rotation, staff and approvals. Can view finance but not post entries.
descriptions.buchhaltung: Contribution margin, pay, payments, state filings. No user management, no field sign-offs.
descriptions.brigade: Accepts picking tasks, records volume and photo evidence in the field, sees rotation and pre-harvest-interval locks.
descriptions.erzeuger: Neighbouring farm supplying produce. Sees its own row blocks, batches, settlement and contracts.
descriptions.kunde: Quotas, pre-orders, price lists, AI chat and released documents.

accessDenied.title: The role {role} has no access to this module.
accessDenied.hint: Switch the demo role at the top right to see the access.

standort.title: Location hierarchy
standort.description: Farm, plantation, field plot, row group, row block. The four-level hierarchy from 1Çatı, one level deeper and named for agriculture.
standort.summary: Four levels and status values renamed, field geometry and trellis orientation added as new attributes.
standort.todo: Admin interface to create and move plots and row groups, field-geometry editor.

reihenbloecke.title: Row blocks and status
reihenbloecke.description: State machine per row block. The 1Çatı unit status translates almost sentence for sentence - including blocked, which here is literally the pre-harvest-interval lock.
reihenbloecke.summary: Structural pattern 'condition locks action until satisfied' reused, condition switched from payment arrears to expiry of the pre-harvest interval.
reihenbloecke.todo: Status changes with mandatory reason, RLS policies per new resource, history per row block.

pflueckaufgaben.title: Picking tasks with photo evidence
pflueckaufgaben.description: workforce_tasks plus media_reports from 1Çatı migration 6 - already a task-with-photo-evidence machine structurally, here per brigade and row block.
pflueckaufgaben.summary: Used directly as a picking task per brigade and row block, photo evidence of the retail punnet on the task.
pflueckaufgaben.todo: Offline capture in the field, evidence review with release and rework, link to quality-factor pay.

pflanzenschutz.title: Plant protection and pre-harvest interval
pflanzenschutz.description: Harvest lock after treatment per row block until the statutory pre-harvest interval expires. A hard legal risk, cutting across all core processes.
pflanzenschutz.summary: 'Lock until condition met' from payment-restriction-control, the condition being expiry of the pre-harvest interval.
pflanzenschutz.todo: Pesticide database with pre-harvest intervals, automatic release on deadline, mandatory record upload.

rotationsplan.title: Rotation plan / picking schedule
rotationsplan.description: Picking interval of two to three days per row block across the multi-week autumn harvest. No precedent in 1Çatı.
rotationsplan.summary: An engine to be built. The finished rotation is exported as a calendar via ics-calendar.ts.
rotationsplan.todo: Interval engine per row block, brigade assignment, conflict check against pre-harvest-interval locks, calendar export.

wetter.title: Weather and growing degree days
wetter.description: A simple weather API link and a growing-degree-days heuristic. Deliberately no ML in phase 1 per the market analysis.
wetter.summary: New. A simple weather API link is enough for the first release.
wetter.todo: Weather-station or API link, growing degree days per plot, alert on shifted ripening windows.

kuehlkette.title: Cold-chain clock
kuehlkette.description: Timing from picking to pre-cooling with a hard 60-minute threshold, temperature logger, target temperature 0 to 1 degree. Highest domain priority.
kuehlkette.summary: No analogue in 1Çatı. The building block on which the entire price spread hangs per the pitch dossier.
kuehlkette.todo: Logger integration, batch clock from the picking time, alarm on threshold breach, KPI calculation.

logistik.title: Collection rounds and route planning
logistik.description: Lifecycle state pattern from booking-lifecycle-repository and move-handover-repository, the domain object switched to a collection appointment.
logistik.summary: Adopt the lifecycle state pattern, switch the domain object from room booking to collection and delivery appointment.
logistik.todo: Route list per vehicle, time windows, handover receipt with temperature and volume reconciliation.

qr_steigen.title: QR crate identification
qr_steigen.description: Scan intake from 1Çatı migration 28 stays, the target object switches from QR-per-zone to QR-per-crate. In the prototype a UI mock without a full server reconciliation.
qr_steigen.summary: QR placement, scan intake and abuse fingerprinting are already built, only the target object changes.
qr_steigen.todo: Label printing per crate, scan at the dispatch point with server reconciliation, mapping crate to batch and task.

esf.title: Electronic delivery note (ЭСФ)
esf.description: ЭСФ and virtual stock via the existing integration_outbox pattern as a bridge. Not a home-built accounting system.
esf.summary: Use the outbox pattern as a bridge. Mandatory integration, no in-house accounting build.
esf.todo: Connection to ИС ЭСФ, evidence chain batch to delivery note, status feedback into the outbox.

rollen.title: Roles and permissions
rollen.description: RBAC engine from 1Çatı lib/rbac.ts. Six core roles directly transferable, the guardianship roles removed.
rollen.summary: Roles as pure data over resources by actions, in sync with SQL helpers. Swappable without touching the engine.
rollen.todo: User management, role assignment, RLS policies rewritten per resource rather than merely renamed.

finanzen.title: Contribution margin and finance
finanzen.description: finance_ledger_entries from 1Çatı. The immutability trigger stays, the cost object is extended by row block, variety and harvest day.
finanzen.summary: The posting logic stays, cost object is new: contribution margin per row block, variety and harvest day.
finanzen.todo: Cost types per harvest day, B2B payment reconciliation, contribution-margin projection per variety.

personal.title: Picker register and brigades
personal.description: Person register transferable from StaffMember. Brigade assignment via workforce_tasks instead of resident assignment.
personal.summary: Person register adopted, brigade and picker ID badge, output and quality factor per person.
personal.todo: ЕСУТД registration per contract, brigade planning, output history as the basis for pay calculation.

lohn.title: Quality-factor pay
lohn.description: Base pay plus a volume component plus a quality factor. A pure piece rate is value-destroying for the raspberry. No precedent in 1Çatı.
lohn.summary: The calculation logic is new, the data model is taken from the harvest-day capture.
lohn.todo: Pay-formula editor, quality factor from the evidence review, settlement run per period, advance account.

dokumente.title: Document management
dokumente.description: document-storage.ts from 1Çatı migration 9. Usable directly for spray records, contracts and ЕСУТД evidence.
dokumente.summary: Container pattern adopted, categories switched to agricultural documents.
dokumente.todo: Versioning, expiry and reminder logic, link to row block and batch.

compliance.title: Compliance cockpit
compliance.description: Consent, retention and audit skeleton from compliance-repository, 1:1. Legal references are swapped out rather than merely translated.
compliance.summary: Skeleton 1:1, Kazakh legal references re-drafted, data residency flagged as an open item.
compliance.todo: Legal references for Tax Code, AI Act, Digital Code, retention rules per data product, hosting-location review.

integrationen.title: State integrations
integrationen.description: ЭСФ, virtual stock, ЕСУТД, subsidy portals gosagro.kz and qoldau.kz. Connected via integration_outbox, not built in-house.
integrationen.summary: Outbox pattern 1:1, one connector per target system, status feedback and retry.
integrationen.todo: Connectors per system, sandbox access, error and retry logic, queue monitoring.

foerdermittel.title: Grant application dossier
foerdermittel.description: Container pattern from document-storage.ts and reporting-repository. Forms for the Kazakh subsidy portals are new.
foerdermittel.summary: Adopt the container pattern, application forms and evidence lists are new.
foerdermittel.todo: Application templates, evidence checklists, deadline monitor, decision-letter filing.

sortenkatalog.title: Variety and quota catalogue
sortenkatalog.description: listings from 1Çatı becomes the variety and quota catalogue. Booking pattern for quotas and pre-orders.
sortenkatalog.summary: listings rebuilt into variety, harvest window, punnet weight, quota and price list.
sortenkatalog.todo: Quota booking with reservation logic, price-list versions, client assignment.

b2b_portal.title: B2B portal
b2b_portal.description: reservations and finance modules from 1Çatı as a booking pattern for quotas, pre-orders and price lists.
b2b_portal.summary: Booking pattern 1:1 for quotas. listings becomes the variety and quota catalogue.
b2b_portal.todo: Client accounts, quota pre-order, delivery-date booking, invoice and payment status.

preislisten.title: Price lists
preislisten.description: Price-list versions per variety and client. Derived from the booking and finance pattern of 1Çatı.
preislisten.summary: Derived from reservations and finance modules, price tiers per client and period.
preislisten.todo: Versioned price lists, tiered prices, validity periods, client assignment.

ki_assistent.title: AI assistant
ki_assistent.description: Retrieval-only chat from public-ai-chat, ai-retrieval and ai-guardrails. Answers only from released sources, logs everything, escalates to a human. In the prototype a placeholder chat window.
ki_assistent.summary: The architecture already meets the verdict 'released sources only, logged, escalation'. Only the knowledge base is swapped.
ki_assistent.todo: Knowledge base of variety catalogue and client FAQ, RBAC gate, transparency notice under the AI Act, escalation path.

aggregator.title: Aggregator / neighbouring farms
aggregator.description: vendor-invoice-repository and the vendors table from 1Çatı. The neighbouring farm becomes a vendor, the purchased volume an invoice line, separate batch tracking is new.
aggregator.summary: Adopt the vendor pattern, separate batch tracking per neighbouring farm is new.
aggregator.todo: Neighbouring-farm onboarding, buy-in capture with its own batch, settlement and payout.

schulungen.title: Training videos
schulungen.description: video-library from 1Çatı. Usable directly for multilingual, image-based short onboarding of seasonal workers.
schulungen.summary: Adopted directly for multilingual, image-based short onboarding.
schulungen.todo: Video content per core process, Kazakh and Russian language versions, progress tracking per person.

reihenbloeckeDemo.distributionLead: Clicking filters the table. The 1Çatı unit status on each tile shows the 1:1 translation.
reihenbloeckeDemo.lockLead: What 1Çatı calls blocked is here literally the statutory harvest lock after plant protection until the pre-harvest interval expires. No picking, no task, no crate from this block.
reihenbloeckeDemo.tableLeadAll: All row blocks across all plantations.
reihenbloeckeDemo.catiNote: Adopted from 1Çatı: the units state machine (occupied, vacant, reserved, maintenance, blocked). Classification Adapt - the pattern stays, the data model and status values are renamed.

pflueckaufgabenDemo.listLead: Per brigade and row block. Progress is actual volume against target volume.
pflueckaufgabenDemo.proofLead: media_reports on the task. Sample photos of the retail punnet, the row block and the crate.
pflueckaufgabenDemo.noProof: No evidence for this task yet.
pflueckaufgabenDemo.reviewLead: The task is waiting for release. Check the volume and the punnet evidence, then release or request rework.
pflueckaufgabenDemo.catiNote: Adopted from 1Çatı migration 6: service_orders, workforce_tasks, media_reports. Classification Adopt - code and architecture stay, only the labelling changes.

standortDemo.statsLead: Four levels below the farm, analogous to 1Çatı Company, Site, Block, Floor, Unit.
standortDemo.treeLead: Farm, plantation, field plot, row group. Row blocks in their own module.
standortDemo.catiNote: Adopted from 1Çatı migration 2 and site-management-data.ts. Classification Adapt - four levels and status values renamed, field geometry and trellis orientation are new.

pflanzenschutzDemo.ruleLead: After a plant-protection treatment, harvest is locked per row block until the product-specific pre-harvest interval expires. A breach is a legal risk, not a convenience matter.
pflanzenschutzDemo.activeLead: Row blocks with a running pre-harvest interval. Release is automatic when the deadline passes.
pflanzenschutzDemo.catiNote: Pattern from payment-restriction-control.tsx (phase-7 debtor logic). Classification Adapt - condition locks action until met, condition switched from payment arrears to expiry of the pre-harvest interval.

rollenDemo.rolesLead: Remapping of the 1Çatı roles admin, manager, accountant, staff, owner, tenant. Guardianship and child roles removed.
rollenDemo.matrixLead: Roles by resources. The same data structure as in 1Çatı lib/rbac.ts.
rollenDemo.matrixNote: Full matrix: 22 resources by 7 actions. RLS policies are rewritten per resource, not merely renamed (analysis chapter 10).
rollenDemo.catiNote: Adopted from 1Çatı lib/rbac.ts. Classification Adopt - the engine stays, six core roles directly transferable, guardianship roles removed.

finanzenDemo.dbTitle: Contribution margin per row block and harvest day
finanzenDemo.dbLead: New cost object: row block, variety, harvest day. Posting logic and the immutability trigger stay from 1Çatı.
finanzenDemo.catiNote: Adopted from finance_ledger_entries and accountant-finance-repository.ts. Classification Adapt - the immutability trigger stays, cost object extended by row block, variety, harvest day.

personalDemo.brigadenLead: Assignment via workforce_tasks instead of resident assignment.
personalDemo.pflueckerLead: Person register from StaffMember. ЕСУТД registration per contract, output and quality factor per person.
personalDemo.catiNote: Adopted from StaffMember and workforce_tasks. Classification Adapt - person register transferable, the pay formula is new business logic.

dokumenteDemo.listLead: Spray records, ЕСУТД evidence, contracts, grant dossiers and certificates.
dokumenteDemo.catiNote: Adopted from document-storage.ts and 1Çatı migration 9. Classification Adopt - usable for spray records, contracts and ЕСУТД evidence.

complianceDemo.cockpitLead: Consent, retention and audit skeleton from 1Çatı. The legal basis switches to Kazakh law.

sortenkatalogDemo.catalogLead: listings from 1Çatı, rebuilt into variety, harvest window, punnet weight, quota and price.
sortenkatalogDemo.catiNote: Adopted from listings. Classification Adapt - listings becomes the variety and quota catalogue, booking pattern for quotas 1:1.

schulungenDemo.libraryLead: video-library from 1Çatı. Multilingual, image-based short onboarding of seasonal workers.
schulungenDemo.catiNote: Adopted from video-library.ts and video-library-player.tsx. Classification Adopt - usable directly.

kuehlketteMock.clockLead: Time since picking against the 60-minute threshold, current core temperature per batch.
kuehlketteMock.hint: Target temperature 0 to 1 degree. Over 60 minutes the price spread collapses - no software substitute for the physical pre-cooling facility.

qrSteigenMock.scanLead: QR per crate. Scan intake and abuse fingerprinting are finished in 1Çatı migration 28, here without a real server reconciliation.

kiAssistentMock.chatLead: Later answers only from released sources, logs every answer, escalates to a human on uncertainty. Knowledge base not yet populated.
kiAssistentMock.demoQuestion: Which varieties are available from September?
kiAssistentMock.demoAnswer: Available from September: Polka and Polana (everbearing), Kweli on request. Tulameen is a summer-bearing variety and not available in September.
kiAssistentMock.stubAnswer: Placeholder answer. In the prototype no knowledge base is connected - the real assistant draws its answer from the released variety catalogue and the client FAQ.

legal.prototypeDisclaimer: Note: Malina is an internal prototype (proof of concept) of WAMOCON GmbH. No real processing of operational or personal data takes place. All data shown is placeholder data.
legal.privacyScopeText: The prototype processes no personal data. No analytics cookies are set. The theme choice (light/dark) and the demo role are stored only locally in the browser.
legal.residencyText: For later live operation, Kazakh Digital Code No. 255-VIII restricts storage of certain data products outside Kazakhstan. The hosting location for the QR, offline-sync and AI architecture will be reviewed legally before going live.
